synergyTileModel: Add 0.10 to the deployed Grand Master synergy-strength factor, then multiply the independent global, owner, and tier factors.
synergyTileEvidence: The +10% tile bonus and prior additive interpretation are explicit. Its interaction with compounded Grand Master synergy strength is unverified by this capture because Militia was off a synergy tile.
